purpose: A20.7 fixed block projection NSN and scalar-DP integration, proximity and input/parameter gradient diagnostics; no training

dataset.training: not applicable; no optimizer, no dataset model selection

randomness.generator: NumPy PCG64; all inputs saved; seed+7 for measurement perturbations; Torch initialization seed recorded; complete checkpoints saved before evaluation; seed+3 for large directional probes

model_evaluation.state: random initialized diagnostic checkpoints, not trained
model_evaluation.small_model: SmoothCorrection: 9x9 affine map followed by tanh
model_evaluation.checkpoint_manifest: evaluated_checkpoints in manifest, recorded before first forward

computation.beta_policy: per-sample, shared U=V; beta0 has NSN derivative including at zero; positive kink uses unclipped branch
computation.coordinates: physical pixel values; weighted measurement norm
computation.unet_gradient_domain: Finite differences on Gaussian input; analytic layer-VJP check on Gaussian and piecewise-constant circle; positive MaxPool ties recorded
